text_block_list.text:
Супер Крик forces herself to race in the
Satsuki
Sho and miraculously pulls off a
victory.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She gives me total credit for her winning
what was
said to be a hopeless race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She then praises me for being an
"amazing
trainer."
text_block_list.name: Монолог
